items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I'd pick Louis Armstrong before 1930, and King Oliver and George Lewis and Baby Dodds and Johnny Dodds both.

ctx.x: Well, I don't really single them out, because I like the sound of a whole band rather than any one musician together. And I suppose if I had to pick any real favorites, of course, in the single musician field, I'd pick Louis Armstrong before 1930, and King Oliver and George Lewis and Baby Dodds and Johnny Dodds both.
Any banjo players? That's what I would like.
